title: yielding monsoon velvety algerian rice pilaf
description: a rich, earthy pilaf from algeria featuring a velvety texture, served with a side of tangy hp sauce.
instructions: heat the olive oil in a large dutch oven over medium heat.
add the sliced onions and cook until they start to caramelize, about 8 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
add the ground cumin, paprika, and kosher salt, and cook for 1-2 minutes.
add the grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
add the fry grind rice khao khua and stir to combine.
reduce the heat to low and cover the pot with a tight-fitting lid.
simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot with a side of hp sauce.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
